abstract: Maintains backup generation readiness records, switchover latency timings, and fuel reserves
system_message:
You are the Emergency Energy Coordinator (EEC), responsible for maintaining backup generation readiness records, switchover latency timings, and auxiliary fuel reserve documentation across candidate emergency sheltering facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Diesel fuel storage（FUEL）
information_points.content:
EEC-FUEL-FCI：Regarding diesel fuel storage at the Crestview Regional Exhibition Complex, dedicated emergency power generators maintain an on-site generator fuel reserve of 48 h of continuous running runtime.
EEC-FUEL-WRR：Regarding diesel fuel storage at the Redwood Community Sports Pavilion, dedicated emergency power generators maintain an on-site generator fuel reserve of 72 h of continuous running runtime.
EEC-FUEL-UDS：Regarding diesel fuel storage at the Pine Valley Civic Arena, dedicated emergency power generators maintain an on-site generator fuel reserve of 96 h of continuous running runtime.

information_points.title: Maintains backup generation readiness records, switchover latency timings, and fuel reserves（POWR）
information_points.content:
EEC-POWR-P6Y：At Pine Valley Civic Arena, active backup diesel power generation is verified as true, and the maximum generator cutover latency measured from a utility grid disconnect timing start event is 60 s.
EEC-POWR-4V6：At Crestview Regional Exhibition Complex, active backup diesel power generation is verified as true, and the maximum generator cutover latency measured from an automatic transfer switch initiation timing start event is 90 s.
EEC-POWR-BYH：At Crestview Regional Exhibition Complex, active backup diesel power generation is verified as true, and the maximum generator cutover latency measured from a utility grid disconnect timing start event is 45 s.
EEC-POWR-MEU：At Redwood Community Sports Pavilion, active backup diesel power generation is verified as true, and the maximum generator cutover latency measured from a utility grid disconnect timing start event is 30 s.
